videos.title: Dil Bechara
videos.description: The universe creates a bittersweet symphony of love, loss, and hope by offering Kizie a pick-me-up in the form of Manny amid the miseries of a terminal illness.

videos.title: Betaab
videos.description: A young man and woman fall in love, but face obstacles from their families. How will the drama unfold?

videos.title: Jhoom Barabar Jhoom
videos.description: At Waterloo station, the Punjabi Rikki meets Alvira, a Pakistani, and they talk; to pass the time while waiting for the train, they discuss the extraordinary circumstances surrounding how they met their respective fiancés.

videos.title: Dhoom 3
videos.description: When a revenge-driven circus entertainer threatens to bleed a Chicago-based banking giant dry, an Indian policeman must leap into action with an eccentric sidekick to save the day.

videos.title: Badmaash Company
videos.description: Four youngsters graduate from college and start a business making a quick buck smuggling foreign goods to India.

videos.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
videos.description: An Indian man living in the US decides to visit his hometown with his new wife and, despite his family's advice, they insist on staying at the ancestral home.

videos.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
videos.description: Sameer is a quick-tempered young man who is shipped off to Goa after losing his temper and getting kicked out of school. There he falls in love with Rani, but she is in love with someone else. To make matters worse, he has offended Rani's father, the disagreeable Colonel Dugraj Singh. Is there any way this romance can end happily?

videos.title: Padmaavat
videos.description: When Sultan Alauddin Khilji hears of the beauty of Rani Padmavati, Rajput queen and wife of Maharawal Ratan Singh, he attacks her kingdom in order to claim her.

videos.title: Angrezi Medium
videos.description: A Rajasthani father goes to extreme lengths to help a daughter pursue higher studies in London. Along the way, misadventures and misunderstandings put their relationship through its paces.

videos.title: Angrezi Medium

videos.title: Parole
videos.description: Two brothers, one a criminal and the other an ordinary citizen, become closer after their mother's unexpected death. The younger one tries to bring out the elder on parole to perform the mother's last rites.

videos.title: Guru
videos.description: A small-time conman finds himself in a soup of problems after he witnesses a murder in the city.

videos.title: Saas bahu aur Sensex
videos.description: Upper middle-class women leave daytime soaps to invest in the stock market.

videos.title: Dhoom
videos.description: A gang of robbers on hi-tech motorbikes, led by the charismatic Kabir, is sweeping through Mumbai, outwitting the police at every turn. When officer Jai Dixit is assigned to catch the criminals, he reluctantly enlists the help of garage mechanic and bike enthusiast Ali. Though the pair do not see eye-to-eye at first, they soon become a formidable team, tracking their enemies from the streets of Mumbai to the beaches of Goa.

videos.title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
videos.description: A man and a woman meet in the middle of their respective failing marriages. They become friends and despite their efforts to try to help each other in salvaging their marriages, they end up falling in love instead.

videos.title: Om Shanti Om
videos.description: A film extra in the 1970s Bollywood is madly in love with a reigning superstar. However, she loves a devious producer, but his greed for power and money is greater than his need for her, and when she comes in the way of his ambitions, he decides to murder her.

videos.title: Kaabil
videos.description: Rohan was a kind, happy, young man until he was struck by a terrible tragedy. Now driven by the fire of vengeance, nothing will stop him, not even the fact that he has been blind since birth.

videos.title: Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai
videos.description: Sanjay gets a surprise phone call from his old friend Anjali and is shocked to hear that she is engaged; since Sanjay has been secretly in love with Anjali for many years, he is also devastated.

videos.title: Guru
videos.description: Aditya, a boxer, sees potential in a vegetable vendor, Rameshwari, and decides to train her. However, the two do not get along due to the former's harsh training style and the latter's hostile nature.

videos.title: Stree 2: Sarkate Ka Aatank
videos.description: The town of Chanderi is being haunted again. This time, women are mysteriously abducted by a terrifying headless entity. Once again, it is up to Vicky and his friends to save their town and loved ones.

videos.title: Akira
videos.description: A college student single-handedly takes on four corrupt police officers in a bid to prove her innocence.

videos.title: Hyderabad Blues
videos.description: A young man finds it difficult to readjust to life in India after spending 12 years in America.

videos.title: Meri Jaan
videos.description: On the road to recovering his debts, a young man realises he is also on his way to falling in love.

videos.title: Ghar
videos.description: Newly married Vikas and Aarti take a trip to the cinema for a late-night movie. When they leave, they decide to walk and end up being assaulted by a gang of men who leave Vikas unconscious and gang-rape Aarti. The incident is heavily publicised, and it leaves Vikas and Aarti traumatised and in a loveless relationship. Can anything save their marriage?

videos.title: Noorie
videos.description: Yusuf and Noorie are engaged to be married, but shortly before the wedding, both Noorie and her father are said to have died. Yusuf believes something far more sinister is going on, and sets out to rescue them.

videos.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana
videos.description: A father and two sons contend with madness and misadventures in the midst of a typical Punjabi family melodrama and action-packed village politics.

videos.title: Dil Bole Hadippa!
videos.description: A feisty cricket expert enters the men's cricket team to play a cricket match. However, she is in a predicament when she falls for her handsome cricket coach.

videos.title: Baghban
videos.description: Raj and Pooja's golden years turn into a dispiriting nightmare when they do not receive the expected love and support from their four grown-up sons.

videos.title: Mimi
videos.description: Mimi, a small-time dancer from Rajasthan, decides to lend her womb to a wealthy American couple to fund her lifelong dream of becoming a Bollywood actress.

videos.title: Housefull
videos.description: Aarush's life is an endless streak of bad luck, be it love, friendships or work. And soon enough, it also becomes a comedy of errors. The more he tries to fight back, the more futile it seems.

videos.title: Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania
videos.description: A girl from Ambala, Kavya Pratap Singh, is about to get married to an NRI. When she visits Delhi to shop for her trousseau, she meets Humpty Sharma, a carefree man, and falls in love with him.
